title: 叛逆神魂GODSOUL🔥

In the Steam web page, go to Store → Points Shop to view animated avatars, backgrounds, and more!

Об игре

RebellionGODSOUL is a story + card battle + anime girl collection RPG game 

The love that stems from the heart, the firm ideal and dedication, will eventually turn into strength,

Link people who resonate, awaken the power of "God Soul", defeat evil, and move towards freedom... 

From now on, I will never be dictated by others 

In 20X1, in the fictional city of Dream City, giant corporations monopolize the internet, AI takes away jobs

People's thoughts are controlled, their time constantly taken away, and their dreams formatted.

But you are the [Rebel] who remains unyielding in adversity and stays devoted to your ideals.

Link with those [Rebel Girls] who resonate with you and share your love for otaku culture.

This time, your youth shall never bow to the oppression of reality!

You'll grow with them, experience conflicts and beautiful moments together, and every heroine has her own relationship rank storyline!

Fictional things materialize as [Linker] girls! Over 40 of them! ❤ Not gacha, not DLC, all included in the base game!

Each [Linker] has her own relationship rank storyline and CG!! Exclusive cards and passive abilities!

 

Fast-paced RPG + card battles, use your will! Freely build your deck [Tactics]

Cards are skills, in a single battle you can command up to 3 Godsouls + 3 Linkers on the battlefield

Abundant cards await your collection! There's also [Card Master Mode] for smoother card battles, with keyboard support! (Can be mapped to steamdeck)

Of course, there's also [RPG Mode], where you can see the battle animations~

Rebel YOU

"Me" (That's you! The Handsome Rebel, you choose your own name~)

A boy who loves anime, digital technology, and artificial intelligence. (18 years old)

Currently working hard to create an AI cat girl...

[Interaction is locked to first-person perspective!]

Game Enthusiast : Kami 

Voice Actor (CV): Hanser/MiHu
age:18

flashy action games always get her extremely excited. During the day, she loves to procrastinate and sleep; at night, she rules the gaming world. She aspires to be a game designer, but no one around her has ever supported her. For some unknown reason, she occasionally twirls her twin ponytails.

Initial GodSoul Awakening: Blazing Rose

Vivid Dream Painter: Lincyage:18

Voice Actor (CV): Cotton candy 

 cute-style artist. She's as gentle and soft as a bunny and believes that cuteness is justice! Even if she gets caught up in her work, she’ll paint cute girls and lose track of time. When painting, it's as if she enters a dreamlike otherworld.

Initial GodSoul Awakening: Phantasmal Snow Dream

Radio Glitter: Hoshimu(StarDream)

Voice Actor (CV): Zhi Mao
age:19

A music Creator who came to the City of Dreams to strive on her own. Touched by virtual idols, she's always working hard to learn singing and dancing, hoping to become an idol who conveys dreams one day. 

Initial GodSoul Awakening: Thunder Rhythm

Cyber Hermit: MoonShadowVoice Actor (CV): Ruo Wu
age:24

A master's student in University, also a programmer in the company.squeezed by both her mentor and the company as a programmer during the day. Off-hours, she transforms into "Spirit Fox," navigating the online world. 

Initial GodSoul Awakening: ??(The current version has not yet joined the team, and will be updated for free in the future)

 
Reality: "Light Cyberpunk" City -REALITY? NOW IS CYBERPUNK-

A peculiarly light cyberpunk city—Dream City.

In 20X1, giant corporations monopolize the entire city.

Virtual reality technology is advanced, AI has replaced countless traditional jobs, holographic advertisements and neon lights line the streets.

Sounds futuristic, right?

Only you know—something is truly off about this world.

Heterotopias

Special space "Heterotopia"

Godsouls, consciousness, cognition, fictional things materialize in Heterotopia

According to different perceptions, Heterotopia is diverse, with half-cyberpunk half-mythological battlefields, cosmic spaces, otherworldly realms, and more...

They—those Linker girls, are attracted to you.

What exactly is Heterotopia? We'll need to explore more.

*all godsouls/Linkers/enemies are over 18 years old
description_short: "GODSOUL" is a story-driven,Hyper-visually RPG. Team with "rebel" girls who love gaming and drawing（and more）, resist villains and enjoy a mix of cyber reality, fantastical worlds, and card game action.
